jsonc-comments.source: DUT source board input and load policy.
jsonc-comments.source.project_context: Project loading mode. auto/schematic loads source SchDocs for power-port detection. Options: auto, none, schematic.
jsonc-comments.output.output_dir: Directory for generated project and artifacts.
jsonc-comments.output.project_name: Base name for generated project documents.
jsonc-comments.output.schematic_sheet_style: Generated schematic sheet size/style, such as D.
jsonc-comments.output.origin: How generated output coordinates are initialized.
jsonc-comments.output.board_outline.mode: Generated board-outline mode. Options: source_bounds, match_source_bounds, match_bounds, source_bounds_with_margin, source_bounds_plus_margin, padded_rectangle, padded_source_bounds.
jsonc-comments.output.board_outline.margin_mils: Board-outline expansion around source bounds in mils.
jsonc-comments.output.overwrite: Allow replacing existing generated output files.
jsonc-comments.output.layer_stack_template: Layer stack template id. Options are supplied by altium-monkey; the generated default uses 2-layer.
jsonc-comments.libraries: Library roots used to resolve mate symbols and footprints.
jsonc-comments.libraries.recursive: Scan library roots recursively when true.
jsonc-comments.validation.source_side: How the source mount side is inferred. Options: infer_single_side, any, none, top, bottom.
jsonc-comments.validation.allow_side_agnostic_through_h: Allow through-hole mate targets to be used across source sides.
jsonc-comments.validation.side_agnostic_kinds: Projection kinds allowed to ignore source side.
jsonc-comments.projections: Named DUT feature groups projected into the mate output.
jsonc-comments.projections.id: Stable projection id referenced by actions/artifacts.
jsonc-comments.projections.source: DUT source selector for this projection.
jsonc-comments.projections.source.object: Source object kind. Options: component, free_pad.
jsonc-comments.projections.source.designators: Designator wildcard/range expression, such as TP* or M1-4.
jsonc-comments.projections.source.hole_size_mils.min: Minimum accepted hole size in mils.
jsonc-comments.projections.source.hole_size_mils.max: Maximum accepted hole size in mils.
jsonc-comments.projections.actions: Actions applied to each matched source object.
jsonc-comments.projections.actions.kind: Action kind. Options: mate_component, reference_graphics, label.
jsonc-comments.projections.actions.part: Known-parts manifest id for seeded mate_component actions.
jsonc-comments.projections.actions.symbol_name: Schematic symbol name for explicit mate_component actions.
jsonc-comments.projections.actions.footprint_name: PCB footprint name for explicit mate_component actions.
jsonc-comments.projections.actions.signal_pad_designato: Pad designator used for generated signal routing.
jsonc-comments.projections.actions.shape: Reference graphics shape mode. Options: source_pad_outline, destination_pad_outline.
jsonc-comments.projections.actions.layer: Target Altium layer for this action.
jsonc-comments.projections.actions.text: Label text source, such as source_net.
jsonc-comments.board_projection: Reference graphics copied from the DUT board.
jsonc-comments.board_projection.cutouts.scope: Board-cutout projection filter. Options: all, interior.
jsonc-comments.board_projection.cutouts.actual_cutouts: Create actual board cutouts when true; otherwise graphics only.
jsonc-comments.artifacts: Optional generated artifacts produced by mate planning/runs.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step: PCB layer STEP artifact generated with the same defaults as pcb-layer-step --init-config.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.enabled: Enable a local STEP model of the selected DUT PCB layer.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.source_layer: DUT PCB layer selector passed to pcb-layer-step. Options: bottom, top, native layer name, layer id.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.z_mm: Bottom Z plane for the exported local STEP bodies.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.thickness_mm: Nominal extrusion thickness for selected copper features.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.include_board_o: Include separate board-outline bodies for visual registration.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.board_outline: Board outline and cutout body styling.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.board_outline.c: STEP color for the outer board outline body.
STEP color for interior board cutout outline bodies.
Include separate outline bodies around interior board cutouts.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.board_outline.w: Outline stroke body width in millimeters.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.board_outline.f: Request planar fusion for board-outline bodies.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.features: Copper feature selection, color, body-name, and thickness-bias policy.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.features.defaul: Fallback feature styling when a feature does not override it.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.features.free_p: Pads not owned by a PCB component.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.features.compon: Component pad mode. Options: none, all, matching_designators.
Case-insensitive shell-style component designator patterns to include.
Rules that split matching pads into separately colored STEP bodies.
Case-insensitive shell-style designator patterns for this highlight.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.drills.mode: Global drill mode. Options: auto, cut, overlay, none.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.drills.selected: Drill mode for pads selected by component_pads. Options: inherit, cut, overlay, none.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.drills.other_co: Drill mode for unselected component-owned pads. Options: inherit, cut, overlay, none.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.drills.free_pad: Drill mode for pads not owned by a component. Options: inherit, cut, overlay, none.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.drills.via_mode: Drill mode for via holes. Options: inherit, cut, overlay, none.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.drills.minimum_: Omit drill overlays/cuts below this diameter.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.drills.color: Default STEP color for drill overlay bodies.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.drills.plated_c: STEP color for plated drill overlay bodies.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.drills.non_plat: STEP color for non-plated drill overlay bodies.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.drills.ring_wid: Fixed annulus width when drill shape is ring.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.drills.plated_r: Plated drill ring policy. Options: annulus.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.drills.overlay_: Z thickness for separate drill overlay bodies.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.fuse_copper: Request Geometer planar fusion for copper bodies.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.insert_in_outpu: Insert the generated STEP artifact into the mate output PcbDoc.
Enable embedding the STEP model in the generated output board.
Model placement Z in the generated output board.
Altium layer used for the embedded STEP model. Options: native layer name, layer id.
Board side used for the embedded STEP model. Options: TOP, BOTTOM, native projection enum id.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.highlights: Projection-driven extra highlight geometries added to the artifact.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.highlights.proj: Projection id whose source pad geometries should be highlighted.
jsonc-comments.artifacts.pcb_layer_step.highlights.colo: STEP color for this projection highlight.

jsonc-key-comments.color: STEP color for this body or rule.
jsonc-key-comments.thickness_bias_mm: Symmetric Z bias that prevents overlapping colored bodies from z-fighting.
jsonc-key-comments.side: Board side selector. Options: top, bottom, left, right, board_left, board_right.
jsonc-key-comments.layer: Altium layer selector. Options: native layer name, layer id.
jsonc-key-comments.font_kind: Text font kind. Options: truetype, stroke, barcode.
jsonc-key-comments.bold: Render text in bold when true.
jsonc-key-comments.text_justification: Altium text justification. Options: Altium text justification enum name, native enum id.
jsonc-key-comments.mode: Mode selector for this object; see the field-specific comment for options.
jsonc-key-comments.box_size_mils: Label box width and height in mils.
jsonc-key-comments.row_spacing_mils: Vertical spacing between generated label rows.
jsonc-key-comments.column_spacing_mils: Horizontal spacing between generated label columns.
jsonc-key-comments.auto_width_padding_mils: Extra padding added to auto-sized label boxes.
